title: Web shop checkout, from cart to doorstep
checked: Every reachable state checked (21 states, 44 with their data, 45 steps). All 4 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 21 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.

rules.rule: No order before a checked address and the money
rules.says: An order exists only after the address passed and the card passed 3-D Secure.
rules.path: Take away the 3DS passed guard and it breaks in 12 steps: sign in, next step, validate, fix it, validate, next step, charge card, retry, charge card, answer 3DS, score, hold stock.

rules.says: Redis holds a unit for every order, so nobody sells the same box twice.
rules.path: Take away the in stock guard and it breaks in 16 steps: as guest, next step, validate, fix it, validate, next step, charge card, retry, charge card, answer 3DS, another card, charge card, answer 3DS, score, approve, hold stock.

rules.rule: A guest order meets a person first
rules.says: A guest checkout has a high fraud score, so a person looks at it before the order.
rules.path: Take away the low risk guard and it breaks in 15 steps: as guest, next step, validate, fix it, validate, next step, charge card, retry, charge card, answer 3DS, another card, charge card, answer 3DS, score, hold stock.
